en.title: Fixed — Filtered graph context
items: Keep every task and phase visible while dimming cards outside the selected filter
Disable nonmatching cards while preserving requested dependency context
Preserve graph positions, zoom and canvas size when filters change

en.title: Fixed — Safe candidate updates
items: Refuse to downgrade a locally installed newer candidate to an older npm latest release
Retry isolated updater cleanup longer on Windows

en.title: Fixed — macOS path aliases
items: Accept the macOS /var to /private/var home alias without allowing linked skill directories

en.title: Improved — Assertive next steps
items: Give one to three concrete suggestions in priority order when a next action is useful
Add a fourth suggestion only to prevent critical failure, loss or blockage
Omit suggestion blocks when no useful next action exists

en.title: Fixed — Persistent Windows dashboard
items: Start the Windows fallback through its registered Startup launcher with the configured environment
Resolve and save the real server process after activation and update restart
Bound process discovery and report the actual restart failure

en.title: Fixed — Dashboard failure recovery
items: Keep serving healthy runs when a workspace or an update file is temporarily unreadable
Recover auto-sync after incomplete state writes or failed synchronization
Report the loaded server version until the process actually restarts

en.title: Fixed — Complete harness updates
items: Report damaged installation markers without silently skipping an installed harness
Continue independent harness updates while reporting partial failure
Treat empty storage settings as unset instead of migrating the current directory

en.title: Fixed — Dashboard filters and zoom
items: Show matching cards across every phase and compact empty lanes
Reveal filtered-out tasks when opening their details
Preserve zoom and pan when toggling the legend

en.title: Fixed — Legacy workspace migration
items: Preserve dependency links and junctions without touching external targets
Resume active legacy attempts while safely deferring structural migration
Verify updates from every published npm version

en.title: Fixed — Interrupted update history
items: Show release notes and installed CLI version after partial failures
Retain missed release history until the whole update succeeds
Report shared migration failures only once

en.title: Fixed — Dependency-aware phase planning
items: Allow user-selected independent phases to be planned concurrently
Block the whole phase when any unfinished member has an unfinished external dependency
Show the blocking dependency phase in the CLI and dashboard

en.title: Fixed — Canonical Prumo storage
items: Keep new central runs in the Prumo store even when legacy settings remain
Follow stale central root references after verified graph-foreman migration

en.title: Improved — Approved graph integrity
items: Tell agents to preserve phase assignments and dependencies instead of rewriting the graph to bypass blockers

en.title: Fixed — Reliable dashboard restart
items: Recover stale or delayed Windows process identity during update
Wait for the previous process to stop before starting its replacement
Allow slower Windows startup without reporting a false failure

en.title: Improved — Fit and 100% view
items: Toggle the fit button between the complete graph and a centered 100% view

en.title: Fixed — Dashboard startup and restart
items: Preserve the configured environment when starting the dashboard
Recognize Windows Startup processes with harmless command-line spacing
Filter dashboard process candidates before exact ownership checks

en.title: Fixed — Safe run migration
items: Refuse to downgrade runs written by a newer state schema
Verify published 1.0.8 upgrades, legacy workspace relocation and merged-task preservation end to end

en.title: Fixed — Central workspace migration
items: Move central graph-foreman workspaces to the Prumo store after byte verification
Preserve project-local runs and roll back conflicting or concurrent changes
Keep an empty Windows-locked legacy directory from reverting a completed data migration

en.title: Fixed — Dashboard continuity
items: Adopt a running legacy dashboard that has no saved startup preference
Preserve explicit dashboard opt-out during installation and update

en.title: Improved — Responsive phase board
items: Choose phase columns from the available canvas
Grow phase lanes only as far as their task cards require
Open with the complete graph visible without manual zoom adjustments

en.title: Added — Direct migration command
items: Expose prumo migrate and prumo migrate --check in the main CLI help
Forward optional run selection to the installed migration engine

en.title: Fixed — Complete update history
items: Show every missed release when updating across multiple versions
Use the oldest installed CLI or harness version as the update starting point

en.title: Added — Automatic legacy run migration
items: Migrate safe pre-planning runs before engine commands and preserve terminal tasks
Create a state backup without opening discussion or planning rounds
Report active work that prevents a safe migration

en.title: Improved — Step-level corrective review
items: Resume at the first invalid review step after a corrective retry
Reuse deterministic static checks only when their declared files are unchanged
Always rerun functional checks

en.title: Fixed — Explicit task scope
items: Keep one discussion and one planner when the user names one task
Treat prerequisites and internal deliverables as plan context instead of new tasks
Require approval before expanding the graph or planning siblings

en.title: Fixed — Sequential phase planning
items: Open phases in declared order after earlier work is terminal
Allow a later provider phase early only for direct or transitive dependency inputs

en.title: Improved — Legacy run adoption
items: Normalize every nonterminal legacy contract before sync-plan
Preserve the original run and adopt eligible phases without auxiliary migration runs

en.title: Added — Automatic global dashboard
items: Start the read-only dashboard after global npm installation
Manage per-user startup with dashboard enable, disable and status commands
Keep Task Scheduler primary on Windows and fall back to one hidden current-user Startup entry without administrator access

en.title: Improved — Responsive graph observer
items: Filter every lifecycle state with optional direct dependency context
Adapt graph density and the collapsible details panel to the available viewport

en.title: Added — Phase-wide discussion and planning
items: Discuss each phase once and generate one immutable plan per task
Track later-phase inputs and replan only confirmed contract or plan defects
Select permitted question tools from the current harness session

en.title: Fixed — Native discovery questions
items: Select permitted question tools from the current harness session
Use structured chat questions when native input is unavailable and wait for real answers

en.title: Added — Task progress visibility
items: Order the legend by lifecycle and color all role counters
Show executor step and review-check progress with explicit retry and cache-reuse events

en.title: Added — Discuss before planning
items: Run task discovery in the principal conversation before dispatching a planner
Require at least one answered question and resolved PO First coverage for every new task

en.title: Added — Host-agnostic discovery
items: Use native questions when available and a structured chat fallback otherwise
Persist and bind discovery context to planning without requiring global Plan mode

en.title: Preserved — Planning and legacy runs
items: Keep discuss, planning, execution and review as separate responsibilities
Keep existing 1.2.0 tasks and state compatible

en.title: Added — Per-task research and planning
items: A dedicated planner researches each new task before execution
Record sources, decisions, execution steps and criterion-to-check mappings

en.title: Added — Planning visibility
items: Separate ready to plan, in planning and ready to execute
Show the planner, task plans and planning time in the dashboard
Keep native run-selector options readable with explicit dark-theme colors

en.title: Preserved — Existing work and independent review
items: Keep legacy task history and replan paused scope changes in the same attempt
Require fresh planning on retry and independent evidence before completion

en.title: Fixed — Legacy run recovery
items: Preserve terminal contracts during sync-plan and retry
Reject malformed working directories before recording validation

en.title: Fixed — Windows state persistence
items: Retry transient state-file locks without deleting previous state

en.title: Added — Executor alias and review guidance
items: Accept start --executor as an alias for --agent
Clarify executable gates, environment failures and independent review

en.title: Fixed — Installation, retry and validation
items: Concise installation progress
Accurate harness detection
Safe retry after approved contract changes
Plan contract preflight and legacy-run recovery
Resumable deterministic validation steps

en.title: Added — Update visibility and compatibility
items: Release highlights after updates
Harness installation matrix

en.title: Improved — Installation and validation flow
items: Improve installation progress and harness detection
Add contract preflight, safe retry and resumable deterministic validation

en.title: Added — Update highlights and install commands
items: Add English update highlights
Document direct installation commands

en.title: Added — Safe graph-foreman migration
items: Migrate existing graph-foreman skills into Prumo after preserving custom files
Verify written files and roll back conflicts while keeping run data in place

en.title: Fixed — Global updates and Codex skill roots
items: Install or update the global CLI through npx and bunx update flows
Keep one personal Prumo skill root in Codex

en.title: Fixed — Windows update progress
items: Clear stale progress labels and use portable ASCII bar segments
Show the installed version after a successful update and suppress successful npm runner notices

en.title: Fixed — GitHub Actions runtime
items: Replace deprecated Node.js 20 action runtimes with Node.js 24

en.title: Fixed — Windows npm execution
items: Remove DEP0190 by invoking cmd.exe explicitly instead of shell:true

en.title: Improved — Concise and repeatable updates
items: Show phase progress while preserving actionable failures and detailed previews
Avoid rewriting complete same-version installations or creating redundant backups

en.title: Added — Persistent global CLI
items: Persist the global prumo command and update it together with installed harness adapters

en.title: Fixed — Dashboard run switching
items: Ignore stale responses when selecting another run and remove duplicate empty-state borders

en.title: Improved — Evidence and corrective retry
items: Separate approved context, current acceptance criteria and executable proof
Synchronize approved contract changes before retry while retaining failures and independent evidence
Recover interrupted dispatch in the existing attempt

en.title: Added — Interactive harness selection
items: Select detected Claude Code, Kiro and Codex environments interactively or with install --all

en.title: Improved — Regional language defaults
items: Select the initial language from the system region and preserve explicit choices
Use the installation language in the dashboard

en.title: Improved — Prumo branding and workspace guidance
items: Standardize the displayed Prumo name while preserving command and data compatibility
Clarify shared workspace setup and preserve explicit storage paths

en.title: Added — npm distribution and automatic updates
items: Publish @henri-ralmeida/prumo and add prumo update
Detect installed environments and custom paths while preserving language, backups and rollback
